notes: DRAFT for C13-4. The dash-only Sensei's Lesson (first-session-lessons.json keys) plus the White floor 4 practice room steps (tutorial-floor.json keys: advance 'tap'/'move', waitFor). Taught once, on White floor 4 with the Sleepy Sentry; health never drops below 1 in this room, and the stripe never overlaps a red circle. Every line teaches the shape cue (striped lane + '!!'), never colour alone: purple-and-white stripes + '!!' can't be COUNTERed, so DASH out; red circle + '!' is COUNTERed. One sentence per screen, under 12 words; tools/check-lessons.py checks it.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: White floor 4: the Sleepy Sentry's first stripe lane appears (game slows)
screens: See the striped lane and the double marks!
lessons.practice: DASH out of the striped lane.
lessons.success: Quick feet! You read the stripes.
lessons.retry: That's okay. The stripes will come again.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the glowing DASH button!

lessons.trigger: The second stripe lane (no slowdown; COUNTER dims, DASH pulses)
lessons.practice: DASH out of the striped lane.
lessons.retry: That's okay. The stripes will come again.

lessons.trigger: First red circle after the stripe lesson (a Wick Wisp joins; never at the same time as a stripe)
screens: A red circle with a single mark means COUNTER.
A striped lane with double marks means DASH.
lessons.practice: COUNTER the circle. DASH out of stripes.
lessons.retry: That's okay. Watch the shape, then choose.

floorSteps.trigger: White floor 4 practice room opens; the Sleepy Sentry is dozing
screens: This stone guard is very sleepy.

floorSteps.trigger: The Sentry yawns and stomps; uses lesson-dash-only
screens: Watch the floor, not just its face.
floorSteps.success: Quick feet! You read the stripes.
floorSteps.retry: That's okay. The stripes will come again.

floorSteps.trigger: Second and third stripes, a little apart; uses lesson-dash-only-hint-2
screens: Here it comes again, and you've got this.
floorSteps.retry: That's okay. The stripes will come again.

floorSteps.trigger: A Wick Wisp joins; its red circle never overlaps a stripe; uses lesson-circle-or-stripes
screens: Now watch the shape, then choose.
floorSteps.retry: That's okay. Watch the shape, then choose.

floorSteps.trigger: Sleepy Sentry calmed; it wakes and stands watch
screens: It's awake now, and it's glad you came.
floorSteps.success: What did the stripes look like?
